notes: 2x found 2026-06-11; PL2303 067b:2303, bcdDevice 3.00 (HXA/clone), no serial - Linux pl2303 driver binds fine, Windows official driver rejects this variant. Metered 2026-06-11: Red-GND=+5.02 V (VCC out), Green-GND idles +3.48 V = 3.3 V TTL so Green=TXD, White=RXD. Mixed-rail: 5 V power but 3.3 V signaling. The 'RS232' label is wrong - cannot drive a true RS232 port (Cubix RS232 idea ruled out; level mismatch would risk damage). When wiring to a 3.3 V target (e.g. Pi GPIO UART) leave Red disconnected or it dumps 5 V into the target rail; RX 5 V-tolerance not guaranteed. No serial -> udev must key on VID:PID or port-path; 067b:2303 differs from SH-U11H EPEver (067b:23a3) but the two identical units collide with each other (need port-path rule).
